sources.fitment_note: The exact Kaspi card identifies JASHI C281F260202-0200 as a one-piece complete front-left strut assembly for Changan UNI-V and lists the individual years 2022, 2023 and 2024 plus 1.5L Turbo. An independent exact OEM catalogue identifies C281F260202-0200 as STRUT ASSY FR-LH for CA UNI V. The three listed years are retained as separate configurations and are not expanded into an inferred continuous or open-ended range. No engine code or broader engine coverage is inferred.
